claims.text: Kivotos Mykonos sits at the far end of a wind-protected private beach reserved for hotel guests.

findings.quote: nestled at the far end of a wind-protected, private beach — a truly private stretch of shoreline reserved exclusively for our guests

claims.text: The hotel's cove has views over Ornos Bay.

findings.quote: This secluded cove offers uninterrupted views over Ornos Bay

claims.text: The suites and villas follow classic Cycladic design and step down a rocky hillside toward the hotel's private beach.

findings.quote: In complete harmony with nature’s handiwork and the classic Cycladic design, the hotel’s 40 suites and villas range in picturesque fashion down the rocky hillside towards their own private beach

claims.text: The private beach is a curve of white sand right below the lower-level pool.

findings.quote: Kivotos has a private beach for the exclusive use of hotel guests, right below the lower level pool. This charming wind-protected curve of white sand

claims.text: The main saltwater pool is on the lower level, just above the private beach.

findings.quote: The main saltwater pool of Kivotos in Mykonos Greece is located on the lower level, right above the hotel’s private beach.

claims.text: The Two Bedroom Suite with Pool combines two interconnecting suites, each with its own queen bedroom, living room and bathroom.

findings.quote: Two (2) Bedroom Suite with private pool in Mykonos is compiled of two interconnecting open plan Luxury Suites, each one with its own Queen bedroom, living room and bathroom.

claims.text: An a la carte Mediterranean restaurant sits on a shaded patio by the pool, overlooking Ornos Bay.

findings.quote: The à la carte restaurant Le Pirate is a seaside paradise of Mediterranean flavors.
It is nestled in a charming shaded patio, right by the pool, overlooking the azure waters of Ornos bay.

claims.text: The hotel's spa is ONAR Spa.

findings.quote: Welcome to ONAR SPA at Kivotos Mykonos

claims.text: The Signature Suite 130 has a private pool with a front made entirely of glass.

findings.quote: ## Signature Suite 130° with Private Glass Pool
features a Private Pool with a front completely made from glass

claims.text: Guests can arrange a private meal, an intimate gathering or a small cocktail party by the beach, in a separate private area or on the hotel's yacht.

findings.quote: Kivotos offers you the option of enjoying a private meal, attending an intimate gathering or a small cocktail party either by the beach, in a separate private area or onboard the hotel’s yacht.

claims.text: The Honeymoon Suite has sea views and an open-air jetted tub.

findings.quote: Honeymoon Suite offers the ideal romantic getaway, complemented by the marvelous sea views and open-air jetted tub.

claims.text: The main pool area has underwater music, a Jacuzzi and a swim-up bar.

findings.quote: the underwater music, the Jacuzzi™, and the swim-up bar
